_note: Convention taken from OutputBox/GLJE/{YYYY_MM}/ (e.g. GLJE_11_03_2025_129334.pdf). The G/L Date line extracts cleanly from the OCR text. The trailing 6-digit id is RANDOMLY GENERATED at rename time -- it appears nowhere in the document. That means a dry run's proposed GLJE name will not equal the name a later live run produces; check the shape, not the exact value. A collision on this value is bad luck rather than a duplicate document, so the worker regenerates instead of raising an exception.

jeNumber._note: Randomly generated at rename time, not read from the document. Confirmed with the business 2026-09-02.
